analysis_md:
解答 $L:\begin{cases}x=a\cos^3t\\y=a\sin^3t\end{cases}$，$\sqrt{x_t'^2+y_t'^2}=3a\sin t\cos t，\quad0\leq t\leq\frac{\pi}{2}$

设质心坐标 $(\bar{x},\bar{y})$，由弧 $L$ 结构可知 $\bar{x}=\bar{y}$。

$$
\bar{x}=\frac{\int_Lx\rho_0ds}{\int_L\rho_0ds}=\frac{\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}a\cos^3t\cdot3a\sin t\cos tdt}{\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}3a\sin t\cos tdt}=\frac{2}{5}a
$$

于是，质心坐标为 $\left(\frac{2}{5}a,\frac{2}{5}a\right)$
